name: A Tanka boat and other sketches
summary: In the principal study two figures operate a Tanka boat, one of them attending to the large perforated rudder.  Above (inverted) is a group of three figures, two of them playing a game on the ground.  At 90° (UL) are two pencil sketches of a dog.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
